description: Create a new block storage instance. Requires zoneCode + blockStorageVolumeTypeCode + blockStorageSize. For XEN: also provide serverInstanceNo to attach at creation. For KVM: cannot attach at creation — use ncloud_attach_block_storage after. Use dryRun=true to preview.

blockStorageSize.description: Block storage size in GB (XEN: 10~2000, KVM: 10~16380, in 10GB increments)

blockStorageSnapshotInstanceNo.description: Snapshot instance number to create block storage from

blockStorageVolumeTypeCode.description: Volume type code. Valid values: SSD, HDD, CB1, CB2, FB1, FB2. Use ncloud_get_block_storage_volume_types to check available types.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating

serverInstanceNo.description: Server instance number (XEN only — creates and attaches to this server. NOT available for KVM)

zoneCode.description: Zone code (e.g. KR-1, KR-2). Required when serverInstanceNo is not provided.

name: ncloud_create_block_storage
